# Flappy Frontier

> A ranked Flappy Bird-style minigame built on the Sui blockchain for the EVE Frontier hackathon (March 2026).

## Live URL
https://flappy-frontier.pages.dev/

## What is Flappy Frontier?
Flappy Frontier is a browser-based side-scrolling game inspired by Flappy Bird, set in the EVE Frontier universe. Players navigate a spaceship through asteroid pipes. The game offers two modes:

- **Practice mode:** Free to play, no wallet required. Play directly in any browser or inside the EVE Frontier in-game browser.
- **Ranked mode (RETIRED here):** the standalone ranked mode with entry fees and weekly prize payouts is retired. The game now lives inside EF-Map (ef-map.com) with free ranked play, paid 100 EVE revives via Frontier Commerce, and NO prizes.

## Key Features
- Canvas 2D game loop running at 60fps with delta-time physics
- On-chain leaderboard and score submission via Sui Move smart contracts
- (Retired) weekly automated prize payouts from the treasury — removed in the EF-Map model
- Provably fair game seeding using sui::random
- Gas-sponsored transactions for seamless gameplay
- Playable inside the EVE Frontier in-game browser (787×1198px portrait webview)

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Vite + React + Canvas 2D
- Smart Contracts: Sui Move (leaderboard, treasury, game seeding)
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages
- Blockchain: Sui (Stillness testnet)
